meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Team-first maximum-saturation research orchestration for omo-senpi. Scopes solo, ALWAYS asks which final format to render (PDF+DOCX default), then stands up a max-size cooperating team (team_create): one member per axis plus skeptic/red-team members for ultradebate/hyperdebate cross-critique, explore/librarian lanes, live ulw-loop journaling, an EXPAND loop until leads run dry, claims proven by code or the claim-graph gate, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind visual-QA and `writing` proofread gates. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research: the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建多智能体辩论团队，穷尽式深挖问题并产出带引用的综合报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果遇到难以定论的复杂课题时，希望自动启动一支多角色研究团队穷尽论证
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate multi-agent deep research and deliver a cited synthesis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a thorough, multi-angle investigation on a hard question without managing many sub-agents yourself.

howto.what: 激活后开始穷尽式研究:先问交付格式,建 8 人满编团队,按轴分工,派怀疑者辩论互评;开探索/图书管理员旁路,循环 EXPAND 至线索枯竭;争议结论用代码或 claim-graph 门验证;产出带引用、图表、附件的报告,过视觉质检与写作校对。
howto.when: 仅当用户明确要求研究时触发:说“ulw-research”、带“ulw”的研究表述或 ultradebate/hyperdebate 请求,或明确要求研究/深度研究等,不限语言。普通提问、调试等不触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 深度调研电动车退役电池的回收路径。
say.note: 会先确认交付格式,再拉起团队开始研究。

say.text: 来个 ultradebate:核能 vs 可再生能源,谁更该被押注?
say.note: 触发辩论交叉评审,结论带引用。

say.text: 做一次深度研究:对比 PostgreSQL 与 MySQL 的高并发表现。
say.note: 成员分头并行探查,最后给出带引用的综合报告。

howto.what_en: Turns Claude into a research orchestrator: asks format, builds 8-member team (axis owners + skeptic), runs explore/librarian lanes & EXPAND loops, proves claims by code, delivers cited synthesis after visual-QA & writing gates.
howto.when_en: Only explicit research demands trigger: "ulw-research", "ulw" research wording or ultradebate/hyperdebate requests, or asks for research/deep research, any language. Ordinary questions/debugging don't.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to deeply research EV battery recycling paths.
say_en.note: Asks the final format first, then starts the team.

say_en.text: Run an ultradebate: nuclear vs renewables, which deserves the bet?
Do a deep research: compare PostgreSQL vs MySQL concurrency.
say_en.note: Spawns members in parallel; delivers a cited synthesis.
